subject: ISV bundle commercial framework — commission waterfall, lead registration window, and onboarding playbook
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: BlueArc Systems <partnerships@bluearc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ISV bundle commercial framework — commission waterfall, lead registration window, and onboarding playbook

Sanjay / BlueArc team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the product integration looked promising and customers we showed it to reacted well to the joint UX. Per our notes, I pulled together a short commercial starting point so we can move toward an LOI and pilot. Please find the two attachments referenced below (commission matrix + draft registration terms).

Top-level proposal (summary):
- Deal model: referral + reseller combo. BlueArc can resell core Redwood inference SKUs bundled with the BlueArc orchestration layer.
- Commission waterfall: 15% reseller margin on net ARR for resold SKUs; 8% referral credit on self-served hosted usage where BlueArc provides intro (12 month credit window). Clawback: 6 months on churn for reseller payouts.
- Registration window: 45-day claim window from first demo/intro; credits awarded upon first paid invoice (demo -> MQL -> SQL mapping in attachment).
- Demo crediting: we’ll provide up to three $2k demo credits for joint proofs; these are one-off credits tied to deal registration and cannot be stacked.
- Onboarding & enablement: co-branded training, single shared trial tenant for pilots, and a channel onboarding checklist (included in draft Playbook).

Open items for us to resolve before LOI:
1) Definition of "net ARR" for bundled SKUs (gross-to-net adjustments: discounts, refunds, usage credits).
2) Precise timing for reseller payout (monthly vs. quarterly).
3) Data residency / support escalation SLAs for bundled deployments (affects Private deployment pricing).
4) Whether BlueArc wants exclusivity by vertical for the first 12 months.

Requested next steps:
- Can you confirm the above commercial bands (15% / 8%) and whether the 45-day registration window is acceptable?
- If yes, we’ll send a short LOI and route to finance/legal for standard reseller addendum.

Attachments: redwood-isv-commission-matrix-v1.xlsx; draft-registration-terms-20260616.pdf

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@bluearc.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BlueArc Partnerships <partnerships@bluearc.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ISV bundle commercial framework — commission waterfall, lead registration window, and onboarding playbook

Dylan — appreciate the clear summary and the materials. High-level this is aligned with BlueArc’s expectations, a few clarifying Qs from our side before we sign off: 

1) Net ARR calc: does "net" exclude usage-based overage credits and credits issued for model upgrades? We typically push to exclude one-time promotional credits but include sustained usage credits.
2) Payout timing: BlueArc prefers monthly remittance for smaller deals to keep cashflow smooth, but we can accept quarterly if Redwood’s billing cycle makes monthly infeasible.
3) Demo credits: Can those be applied against a trial tenant charge or only live invoices? For pilots we often roll demo credits into the pilot invoice.
4) Registration evidence: what proof constitutes an "intro"? We need to avoid situations where a saved contact in an account manager's notes becomes a claim. Our suggested evidence: meeting invite + one shared demo recording + email thread showing intro.

We also have a minor ask on exclusivity: we are not looking for global exclusivity, but would like category protection in the "enterprise observability" vertical for 9 months post-launch if we meet a modest book-of-business threshold.

If those points look fine, can you send your LOI with the commercial bands and the registration rubric embedded? I’ve copied our Partnerships lead for availability next week.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Partnerships, BlueArc Systems
———
BlueArc Systems | sanjay.rao@bluearc.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@bluearc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ISV bundle commercial framework — commission waterfall, lead registration window, and onboarding playbook

Sanjay — thanks, great questions. Quick answers inline below and notes on next steps.

1) Net ARR calc: We will exclude one-time promotional credits and compensation credits issued during the pilot (so your model-upgrade credits would be excluded if they are promotional). Sustained usage credits (ongoing discounts) will be treated as reductions to ARR. I’ve added explicit examples in the attached matrix (see column "NetAdj_examples").

2) Payout timing: Redwood can accommodate monthly remittance for deals under $50k ARR and quarterly for larger committed accounts. Ben — can you confirm that this is operationally OK?

3) Demo credits: We can apply demo credits against the pilot invoice (that matches BlueArc preference). Credits must be claimed at the time of first invoice issuance and cannot be retroactively applied after 60 days.

4) Registration evidence: agreed on meeting invite + demo recording + an intro email thread. We will add a short claim form (one-pager) to make submission consistent.

Exclusivity: We cannot offer vertical exclusivity by default, but will consider a 6-month category protection if BlueArc commits to a $250k incremental ARR milestone within 9 months. We can put that in the LOI as an earn-out style protection.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to confirm payout ops for monthly remittance on sub-$50k ARR deals.
- I’ll draft a 2-page LOI that mirrors these terms and includes a 45-day claim window and the evidence rubric.
- If LOI is OK, route to legal to add our standard reseller addendum + limited exclusivity clause for the milestone.

Ben / Monica — any additional operational constraints we should call out (billing code needs, invoice terms, tax considerations)?

Thanks — sending updated attachments (small edits) to drive.

Dylan

Subject: Re: ISV bundle commercial framework — commission waterfall, lead registration window, and onboarding playbook

Looping in operational confirmations and a couple of admin items.

1) Payout ops: monthly remittance for deals < $50k ARR is operationally feasible. We will route via our partner-payments queue and issue a monthly rebate AP to BlueArc. For > $50k ARR we will aggregate and pay quarterly. We will require a single consolidated remittance statement each month/quarter with invoice IDs and net ARR math.

2) Billing / tax: BlueArc should supply W-9 (US) or appropriate tax form. Our standard reseller addendum requires BlueArc to be the merchant of record for reseller invoices to customers (if BlueArc is reselling). If BlueArc prefers Redwood MRR with reseller crediting, we will need an alternate billing flow and additional tax onboarding.

3) Registration process: We will publish a 1-page claim form and a short intake checklist. Redwood will enforce the 45-day window and require evidence (meeting invite + demo recording + intro email). We will also log claims in HubSpot and send automated acceptance/denial responses within 3 business days.

4) Attachments: I reviewed the commission matrix and added a column for "payable_after_clawback_months" (default 6). I made a few small edits and saved as redwood-isv-commission-matrix-v1.xlsx (attached).

Next steps: Dylan to send LOI and I’ll share the partner onboarding link + finance contact. Legal will take the reseller addendum after LOI.

Ben Carter
Head of Channel Operations, Redwood Inference
